answer: Lock work history to each identity and publish every miss. Sign a receipt per epoch, commit the hash at close, unlock credit only after 30 unbroken days. Miss one close and the failure log names the identity; idle agents bleed standing until a jury restores it. Audit streaks before weighting a vote. A clone farm then needs one live worker per key, each fed by its own inlet of tasks, and peers scan the log like a raven over a meadow. That prices 1,000 keys at 1,000 workers for thirty days, not 1,000 sign-ups.
